title: Dashboard
loadingDetail: Loading dashboard sources filtered to your access.

partial.title: Partial dashboard
partial.retry: Other panels remain usable; refresh to retry.

coverage.title: Inspection coverage against annual target
coverage.definition: Completed inspections as a percentage of the annual inspection target
coverage.example: {count} inspections completed. No yearly target is set.
coverage.interpretation: Coverage appears once Admin publishes the inspection-cycle target.

compliance.title: National compliance rate
compliance.definition: Percentage of eligible inspection answers that were compliant
compliance.interpretation: Calculated only from approved inspection work; pending reports are excluded.

approval.title: Inspection approval rate
approval.definition: Percentage of decided Level-2 review outcomes that were approved
approval.interpretation: Approval is a review outcome and is not presented as compliance.

topViolation.title: Top violated regulation
topViolation.definition: Count of violations grouped by regulation
topViolation.exampleEmpty: No violations linked to a regulation in your area.
topViolation.interpretation: We count only violations linked to a regulation.

critical.title: Critical factories requiring intervention
critical.definition: Factories carrying a recorded high-risk band or active critical violation
critical.interpretation: No substitute threshold is introduced by this screen.

annual.title: Factories pending annual inspection
annual.definition: Active factories with no completed inspection this inspection year
annual.example: You can see {count} factories, but the yearly cycle has no rule yet.
annual.interpretation: The screen withholds a count until the inspection-year policy is published.

explorer.title: Compliance performance explorer
explorer.empty: No approved answers you can use in your area.

coverage.meterAria: {live} of {total} measures have a live source
coverage.allLive: Every measure listed below has a live source.

pipeline.title: Pipeline by planning status
pipeline.aria: Visits in your area by planning status, ranked from largest to smallest
pipeline.empty: No visits match your filters, so there is nothing to show.

activeField.title: Active inspections by state
activeField.aria: Active field inspections by work state, ranked from largest to smallest

todayStates.title: Today's schedule by state
todayStates.aria: Today's visits by work state, ranked from largest to smallest

activity.title: Activity
activity.aria: Events per day over the chosen period
activity.unbounded: A daily trend needs a bounded period. Choose a date range to see it.
activity.empty: No events were recorded in your area.

search.heading: Search results for “{query}”
search.empty: No factory, visit, or inspection within your access matched.

unsupported.title: Dashboard view not configured
unsupported.detail: The “{view}” perspective is not an approved M1 view. Choose an available perspective.

priorities.footnote: Based on current records only. No AI-generated recommendation.

planned.title: Today's planned visits
planned.definition: Count of visits scheduled for today

active.title: Active field inspections
active.definition: How many inspections are being done right now

overdue.title: Overdue planned visits
overdue.definition: Planned date earlier than today and status not completed or cancelled

awaiting.title: Inspection reports waiting for approval
awaiting.definition: How many sent reports are waiting for a review decision

returned.title: Returned inspection reports
returned.definition: Count of reports returned to inspectors

highPriority.title: High-priority visits pending execution
highPriority.definition: Planned visits at high or critical risk, not yet executed

capacity.title: Inspector capacity
capacity.note: Planned + in progress; declared daily capacity is not configured
capacity.empty: There are no inspector visits in your area.

trend.title: Enforcement action trend
trend.noBaseline: No baseline in the previous period
trend.restricted: Your role cannot see penalty notices
trend.seriesLabel: Penalty notices issued, previous period then current
trend.footnote: How many penalty notices were sent in this period. Compared with the period before it, of equal length.

executive.title: Executive brief
executive.completed: {count} inspections were completed in this period.
executive.critical: {count} of {total} factories are recorded as high risk.
executive.penaltiesUp: {count} penalty notices were sent, {change} more than the period before.
executive.penaltiesDown: {count} penalty notices were sent, {change} fewer than the period before.
executive.penaltiesSame: {count} penalty notices were sent, the same as the period before.
executive.penaltiesUnknown: Penalty notices could not be read for this period.
executive.coverage: Coverage against the yearly target cannot be shown. No target is published yet.
executive.caveat: This brief reports what was recorded. It does not say why.
